name.zh: 受 Naraoia 启发的双盾节肢动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish two large smooth shields conceal rows of delicate walking limbs in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以两块大型光滑背甲下藏多排细足搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

reconstruction_notes.en: Nominal scale, color, pose and repeated detail counts are artistic choices; no exact species/specimen/coexistence reconstruction. Original geometry only.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
